items.markdown:
Client retention is `a business’s ability to keep existing customers engaged and buying over time`.[[1]](https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-experience/retention/customer-retention/)[[2]](https://www.salesforce.com/service/digital-customer-engagement-platform/customer-retention/)

### Why It Matters

- **Lower Costs:** It costs significantly less to keep an existing buyer than to find a new one.
- **Higher Profit:** Small boosts in your retention rate can lead to large profit increases.
- **Better Value:** Loyal customers buy more often and spend more per order.[[1]](https://www.netsuite.com/portal/resource/articles/crm/customer-retention.shtml)[[2]](https://www.zoom.com/en/blog/customer-retention-strategies/)[[3]](https://www.act.com/what-is-customer-retention/)[[4]](https://inmoment.com/blog/customer-retention/)

### How to Calculate It

To find your **Customer Retention Rate (CRR)** , use this basic formula:[[1]](https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-experience/retention/calculate-customer-retention-rate/)[[2]](https://www.salesforce.com/ap/service/digital-customer-engagement-platform/customer-retention/)  
CRR=Total Customers at End−New Customers Acquired Total Customers at Start×100 CRR equals the fraction with numerator Total Customers at End minus New Customers Acquired and denominator Total Customers at Start end-fraction cross 100 C R R=T o t a l C u s t o m e r s a t E n d−N e w C u s t o m e r s A c q u i r e d T o t a l C u s t o m e r s a t S t a r t×1 0 0

### Top Strategies to Retain Clients

- **Improve Onboarding:** Help new buyers find value in your product or service right away.
- **Be Proactive:** Reach out with helpful tips, check-ins, or support before problems happen.
- **Personalize the Experience:** Tailor your messages and offers to fit individual user needs.
- **Listen to Feedback:** Collect customer reviews and act on complaints quickly.
- **Reward Loyalty:** Offer special perks, discounts, or programs for repeat buyers.[[1]](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/customer-retention)[[2]](https://www.zoom.com/en/blog/customer-retention-strategies/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Z8ed_3qkK8)[[4]](https://www.qualtrics.com/articles/customer-experience/customer-retention/)[[5]](https://www.salesforce.com/service/digital-customer-engagement-platform/customer-retention/)[[6]](https://www.act.com/what-is-customer-retention/)

Learn more detailed frameworks and tools through guides like [IBM's Customer Retention Overview](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/customer-retention) or [NetSuite's Retention Strategies](https://www.netsuite.com/portal/resource/articles/crm/customer-retention.shtml).[[1]](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/customer-retention)[[2]](https://www.netsuite.com/portal/resource/articles/crm/customer-retention.shtml)If you want, tell me:
